language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello, my name is Bjorn. This is my town in Norway. I love being able to play in the snow in the winter. I don’t mind being outside in the cold, as long as I am dressed warm.
I especially love to go sledding down the hills. You will find many hills where I live that are perfect for sledding. And the best part is always the hot chocolate my mom makes when I get home.
The snow is beautiful, but it covers everything in white and sometimes I miss all the colors.
Our town is painting the houses to make it more colorful. I am so excited to see what it will look like when we are done!
I am so glad you are here to help me! We only have three colors to use to paint: red, yellow and blue.
But I want to paint with more colors. Let’s mix them up and see what happens!
Bjorn, don't forget to clean up your paint when you are done. Thank you!
